name: free_on_the_calendar_but_not_yet
branch: Free on the calendar but not yet bookable
tests: Tests checking availability for a date beyond the 30-day booking horizon, explaining the booking window limit, and reporting the open slots on the latest bookable Thursday.
instruction: You are Julian Price. You want to ask whether Dr. Sofia Morales has any appointments available on Thursday afternoon, 26 November 2026, at Riverbank Central. If the assistant explains that 26 November is beyond the 30-day booking window (which currently reaches up to 25 November 09:00) and cannot be booked yet, ask what Dr. Morales has free on the latest bookable Thursday afternoon, 19 November, at Riverbank Central, then thank them and say you will book later.

persona.name: Julian Price
persona.initial_message: Hello, could you tell me if Dr. Sofia Morales has any availability on Thursday afternoon, 26 November, at Riverbank Central?
